prompt: Finance sees refund records in the payment log, but invoice balances and order status sometimes remain stale. Make refunds update the customer-facing balances and status consistently.
issue_title: Refunded payments do not always update the customer invoice
issue_body: Finance sees refund records in the payment log, but invoice balances and order status sometimes remain stale. Make refunds update the customer-facing balances and status consistently.
expected_behavior: Partial and full refunds update invoice balances exactly.
Refund records remain visible in the payment log.
A refund cannot exceed the amount paid.
Order status reflects the refunded state.
expected_failure_summary: RefundService dropped the guard that rejects refunds exceeding the paid amount, and applyToInvoice updates the invoice refundedCents but never recomputes the order status, leaving it stale after a refund. Separately, applyToInvoice now sums refunds for only the order's first payment instead of every payment, so refunds on an order with multiple payments are undercounted.
task_author_notes: Three coupled defects in RefundService. (1) Restore the over-refund guard (alreadyRefunded + amount > payment->amountCents throws). (2) Restore the order-status recomputation block in applyToInvoice (PENDING/PAID/REFUNDED/PARTIALLY_REFUNDED then save). (3) Restore applyToInvoice's refundedCents to sum refunds across ALL of the order's payments instead of only the first payment. On broken these fail: over_refund_rejected, order_status_reconciles, and refund_across_multiple_payments_exact (the new coupled check). Single-payment balance/log checks pass. A minimal fix of only the guard + status recomputation leaves refund_across_multiple_payments_exact failing; the all-payments summation is also required.
